title: Design Closure persona and dialogue evaluation fixtures
objective: Deliver a concise source-grounded role card, a 38-scene provenance index, 40 original evaluation cases and a practical model/context evaluation protocol. This stage produces reviewable design artifacts; no live prompt/backend/voice/memory implementation or paid inference is part of this stage.
architecture: The user selected the next step after providing the PRTS voice-record page: prepare the compact role card and evaluation questions before choosing a new backend. Codex authors directly under the standing override. Reuse the clean isolated checkout on a dedicated design branch, retaining the accepted animation fix and all live/legacy customizations.

Use the supplied public PRTS voice page and the inspected 38 scene labels. Store only scene metadata/provenance, compact paraphrased interpretation and original test fixtures; source game dialogue/audio stays at its reference URL. Distinguish sourced characterization from desktop adaptation rules.

Keep the role card separate from response JSON format, source catalog, user memory and evaluator rubrics. The role card contains no answer demonstrations. Do not change the deployed system prompt; the current gpt-6.1-sol configuration and voice adapter remain the baseline.

Define 40 original cases in eight categories with five cases each. Separate 30 model-only fixtures from 10 application-integration cases requiring future memory/session services. Judge meaning and behavior, not a single canonical reply. All setup data and assistant context/protocol fixtures are explicitly synthetic.

Declare an allowlist of model-visible fields; evaluator expectations, reference IDs and state oracles never enter generation prompts. Maintain equal history/memory fixtures when comparing model families. Distinguish current end-to-end single-turn baseline from controlled model comparisons, so orchestration changes are not attributed to model quality.

Keep all model results empty and execution status NOT_RUN. Validate artifact structure, IDs, references, grouping, fixture consistency and role-card length offline. Existing code/runtime tests are unchanged and are not a substitute for future model/style or memory-behavior evaluation.

Document the existing live-only AI client and reasoning-policy changes as a baseline dependency for any later implementation. No Claude calls, real user transcript/config reads, real memory writes, cloud resources, model downloads, training, API fees, source promotion or daily-app activation occur in this design step.
non_goals: No changes to src, pom, deployed prompt, animation, voice, AI settings, application storage or service processes.
No game transcript/audio corpus in the repository; no real user messages, credentials, local configuration, schedules, recordings or weights in fixtures.

No real inference, synthesized voice, model ranking, benchmark scores, automatic selection or claim of user acceptance. No development dispatcher start/publish/finalize while this work is design-only.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A source index identifies all 38 unique voice scenes and their revision/retrieval provenance, with 21 interaction, 16 tactical and one title entry under the stated working classification.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Offline JSON checks for source fields, unique IDs, scene counts and grouping; no transcript/audio payload fields.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A compact role card and evidence map distinguish characterization from desktop-specific behavior and protocol; examples do not become fixed answers or user memories.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Editorial review, evidence reference checks, bounded role-card size and unchanged live prompt/source.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Forty original cases cover eight categories, equal category counts, separate model/integration tracks, concrete expected behaviors, clear failure conditions and synthetic fixtures.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Offline structural/reference validation and full case review; model input allowlist and judge-only metadata are explicit.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The evaluation protocol defines controlled model comparisons, context/memory variants, scoring, unsupported-capability treatment, leakage boundaries and unexecuted result status.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Cross-check README against JSON and existing reply/memory contracts; no fabricated model or application outcome.

risks: The 38 scripted source scenes are not 38 independent natural conversations; tests remain a small reviewed design set, not demonstrated generalization.
Source scene conditions and paraphrased interpretation cannot establish acoustic performance. Audio evaluation requires separate paired material and real listening.
Memory/session target behavior is a proposed application contract. Unsupported current capabilities and unrun model outputs must not be marked PASS.
Any future runtime implementation must preserve live-only AI client/reasoning changes and private voice/settings; the draft artifacts do not authorize fees or silently activate a new model.
rollback: Remove or revise only these design artifacts on the dedicated branch. No live app, settings, data or source files are modified, so no runtime rollback is required.
